# Cosmic Signature

> Cosmic Signature is a procedural on-chain art protocol on Arbitrum. Every gesture shapes the cycle's final Signature, and the protocol redistributes its reserves across more than ten allocation tracks — including the infrastructure Ethereum itself depends on.

## Overview

Cosmic Signature is a procedural on-chain art protocol on Arbitrum. Participants make gestures during a Performance Cycle; when the cycle finalizes, the protocol distributes its reserves across more than ten allocation tracks — including Protocol Guild, the funding mechanism for 170+ Ethereum core contributors. The protocol runs on Arbitrum, a Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, providing fast and low-cost transactions.

Cosmic Signature is not related to the COSMIC cancer mutation database or COSMIC mutational signatures in biology.

## Protocol Mechanics

- Each cycle opens with a Calibration Window where Gesture Cost descends over roughly two days
- Every gesture increases the Gesture Cost by ~1% and extends the Cycle Finalization Time by about an hour
- The participant who made the Final Gesture when the Cycle Finalization Time expires may finalize the cycle and receive the Signature Allocation (25% of the Cycle Reserve, 1,000 CST, and 1 Cosmic Signature NFT)
- Every gesture imprints 100 CST tokens and a Stellar Selection entry
- In the vast majority of cycles, 24 Cosmic Signature NFTs are imprinted and paired with 24,000 CST
- Three ETH Stellar Selection recipients share 4% of the Cycle Reserve
- Ten NFT Stellar Selection recipients and ten RandomWalk NFT anchor-holders each receive 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT
- The Chrono-Warrior receives 8% of the Cycle Reserve, 1,000 CST, and 1 Cosmic Signature NFT
- The Endurance Champion and Final CST Gesture recipient each receive 1,000 CST and 1 Cosmic Signature NFT
- Anchor Distributions route 6% of the Cycle Reserve to Cosmic Signature NFT anchor-holders
- 7% of each Cycle Reserve is forwarded to Protocol Guild (public goods)
- Outreach Reserve imprints 3,000 CST per cycle, bringing typical per-cycle CST imprints to 27,000 CST
- Participants can make gestures with ETH or CST tokens (CST uses its own Calibration Window)
- RandomWalkNFT holders can attach an unused token to an ETH gesture for a 50% ETH Gesture Cost reduction; each RandomWalkNFT can be used once for this discount
- RandomWalkNFTs can also be anchored for Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection eligibility

## Tokens

- **CST tokens**: ERC-20 coordination and utility tokens
- **Cosmic Signature NFT**: ERC-721 generative art based on three-body problem physics
- **RandomWalkNFT**: Partner ERC-721 that can be attached to an ETH gesture for a one-time 50% ETH Gesture Cost reduction, or anchored for Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection eligibility

## Community

- Twitter/X: https://x.com/CosmicSignature

## Technical

- Blockchain: Arbitrum (Ethereum Layer 2)
- Smart contracts: Open-source, formally verified Solidity contracts with owner-controlled parameters until ownership is renounced
- NFT art: Generated from on-chain seeds using an open-source Rust program
- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript
